items.title_orig: Who are your Top 3 favourite bassists?
items.article_text:
Who are your top 3 faviourite bassists, the ones who influence your sound the most or who you just like their work? My top 3 are:
  
Cliff Burton (Metallica) - I still question why he tried to make bass sound like a guitar instead of just playing guitar lol. He was such a musical genius on the bass and in general. The 3 albums we got to hear him on were incredible. 'For Whom The Bell Tolls', 'Orion', etc, all have incredible basslines. It is a shame he was taken from this world as he was starting to really show his genius to the world. I like how Cliff worked around James, Lars and Kirk most of the time, not just mimic James's rhythm guitar.
 
Roger Waters (Pink Floyd) - Yes he may be a little bit of a prick nowadays, but you can't deny this guy was also a musical genius on and off the bas
